# @vllnt/convex-analytics

> TypeScript Convex component for event analytics: track events, roll up counts on write, and query metrics, breakdowns, time series, funnels and retention.

Mount it with `app.use()` and call it from your Convex functions through `AnalyticsClient`.
`track` stores the raw event and increments rollup rows for the props keys you declare as
`dimensions`; `metric`, `top` and `timeseries` read those rollups, `funnel` and `distribution`
read retained raw events, `uniques` and `retention` read per-subject first/last-seen rows, and
`list` pages raw events. Subjects, sessions and props are opaque host data; the component reads
no auth. Opt-in entries: `@vllnt/convex-analytics/web` (web dimensions, user-agent and geo
helpers), `@vllnt/convex-analytics/react` (hooks), `@vllnt/convex-analytics/test` (convex-test
helper). Peer dependency: `convex@^1.45.0` (`react@>=18` optional, imported only by `./react`;
a transitive dependency still declares `react` as a required peer).

These docs ship inside the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-analytics/` and match the
installed version, as do `src/` and `CHANGELOG.md`.

## When to use

- Use it when a Convex app needs event counts, breakdowns and time series that its own queries read reactively.
- Use it when you know the props you slice by up front, so counts can be rolled up as each event is written.
- Use it when you also need funnels, retention cohorts, distinct-subject counts or histograms over retained raw events.
- Do not use it when you need cookie-consent state and consent-gated tracking in a React app: use `@vllnt/analytics`.
- Do not use it when you need a per-subject activity feed read back event by event: use `@vllnt/convex-events`.
- Do not use it when you need A/B variant assignment with exposure tracking: use `@vllnt/convex-experiments`.

## Docs

- [API table](./README.md#api): every export of every entry point and the two component functions the client does not wrap, one line each
- [Errors and fixes](./README.md#errors-and-fixes): every error code and message, cause and fix
- [Limits and gotchas](./README.md#limits-and-gotchas): caps, defaults, silent no-ops
- [Quick Start](./docs/quick-start.md): install, mount, track, read
- [Client SDK](./docs/client-sdk.md): `AnalyticsClient` config, methods, types, `convex.config`, test helper
- [Web Preset](./docs/web-preset.md): opt-in web dimensions, user-agent and geo helpers
- [React hooks](./docs/react.md): `useMetric`, `useTop`, `useTimeseries`, `useUniques`
- [REST API](./docs/api-reference.md): the five routes (/track, /metric, /top, /timeseries, /uniques)
- [Schema](./docs/schema.md): events, rollups, subjects, sessions, scopes, config and indexes
- [Multi-Product](./docs/multi-product.md): the opaque `scope` partition
- [Architecture](./docs/architecture.md): rollup-on-write, child components, crons
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): version history
